Package com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.engine

Interface InferenceEngine<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the underlying model type (e.g., SavedModelBundle for TensorFlow)
All Known Implementing Classes:
HttpInferenceClient, LocalInferenceEngine, OnnxInferenceEngine, PmmlInferenceEngine, RemoteInferenceEngine, SageMakerInferenceClient, TensorFlowGraphDefEngine, TensorFlowInferenceEngine, TensorFlowSavedModelEngine, VertexAIInferenceClient, XGBoostInferenceEngine
public interface InferenceEngine<T>
Core interface for ML inference engines in Otter Stream.

All inference engines (TensorFlow, ONNX, PyTorch, XGBoost, etc.) implement this interface to provide a uniform API for model loading and prediction.

Lifecycle:

  1. initialize(ModelConfig) - Load and prepare the model
  2. isReady() - Verify engine is ready for inference
  3. infer(Map) or inferBatch(Map[]) - Make predictions
  4. close() - Release resources

Implementation Example:


 public class MyCustomEngine implements InferenceEngine<MyModel> {
     private MyModel model;

     @Override
     public void initialize(ModelConfig config) {
         this.model = loadModel(config.getModelPath());
     }

     @Override
     public InferenceResult infer(Map<String, Object> inputs) {
         // Run prediction and return result
     }
 }
